What operating cost includes

Grid purchases less export revenue, carbon charges, battery degradation, source-specific curtailment penalties and load-shift compensation, less demand-response incentive revenue. These are simulated operating costs; they exclude asset capital costs and do not establish profit or payback.

UNCERTAINTY

Keep room for what changes

The planner evaluates demand and generation forecasts over a short horizon. Forecasts are synthetic estimates, and decisions are revised from new observations each cycle.

Inspect “Analyze” and “Plan” in Agent activity to see the selected priorities, operating risks, and planned reserves.

SUCCESS CRITERIA

Measure the trade-offs

Cost and grid-emissions comparisons use the same simulated telemetry with a no-storage baseline. Demand served and renewable utilization use measured energy totals.

Both deferral and unserved demand are visible. A cheaper decision can have a worse reliability result.

DESIGNED FOR EXPLAINABILITY

One agent. Six accountable steps.

A bounded decision engine observes a synthetic microgrid, compares feasible actions, executes simulated tools, and checks the result.

MODELING

Explicit constraints, synthetic inputs

  • Eight renewable assets expose generation and maintenance availability.
  • Two batteries track energy, efficiency, power limits, throughput and modeled health.
  • Three consumers expose critical demand, flexible demand, deferral and restoration.
  • Two parallel grid lines constrain imports and exports; frequency is a simplified planning proxy.
  • Carbon prices, demand incentives, solar/wind curtailment and maintenance enter decisions.
IMPLEMENTATION

Runs entirely in your browser

  • Deterministic seeded simulation and local history.
  • Bounded look-ahead search with explicit objective trade-offs.
  • Simulation tools return action receipts for inspection.
  • No connected LLM, trained forecasting model, or equipment connection.
  • Best explored candidate; no proof of a global optimum.
EVIDENCE

Show what the prototype does

  • Replay a cycle’s observation, decision, execution and checks.
  • Compare candidate scores for the current objective.
  • Change input assumptions or inject a disturbance and inspect the revised decisions.
  • Inspect consumer allocations, line flows, battery health and maintenance receipts.
  • Export interval records and cumulative metrics as JSON or CSV.
Simulation only

This hackathon prototype demonstrates orchestration logic. It is not calibrated for grid operations, certified optimization, or settlement. All prices, forecasts, emissions factors and equipment states are synthetic.
